title: Select a column
summary: Selecting one column by name returns a Series. A Series is a labelled one-dimensional set of values.
introduction: Selecting one column by name returns a Series. A Series is a labelled one-dimensional set of values. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Selecting one column by name returns a Series. A Series is a labelled one-dimensional set of values.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Asha", "Ben", "Cara"],
    "score": [8, 6, 9],
    "team": ["red", "blue", "red"]
})

print(df["score"].tolist())
blocks.title: Select a column

blocks.text: The output is [8, 6, 9]. Only the score column is selected.
